Package com.squad93.pos.db

Class DatabaseConfig

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.db.DatabaseConfig
public final class DatabaseConfig extends Object
Loads PostgreSQL credentials from a properties file and environment overrides. DB_URL, DB_USER, and DB_PASSWORD take precedence over file values.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static DatabaseConfig load() throws IOException
      Loads db.properties from the working directory with process environment overrides.
      Returns:
      validated database settings
      Throws:
      IOException - if an existing settings file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if required values are missing or the URL is not PostgreSQL

    • load

      static DatabaseConfig load(Path path, Map<String,String> environment) throws IOException
      Loads an optional UTF-8 properties file and applies the supplied environment overrides.
      Parameters:
      path - settings file; a missing file is allowed when overrides provide all values
      environment - environment values keyed by DB_URL, DB_USER, and DB_PASSWORD
      Returns:
      validated database settings
      Throws:
      IOException - if the settings file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if required values are missing or the URL is not PostgreSQL

    • connectionProperties

      public Properties connectionProperties()
      Builds fresh JDBC properties containing credentials and connection timeouts. Connect, login, and socket timeouts are five, ten, and fifteen seconds, respectively.
      Returns:
      a new properties object suitable for JDBC connection creation
